purpose: Measure the work required to adopt a model through the captured compiler and native serving runtime without fabricating unknown implementation costs.
measurement_rules: A row may use null when the receipt does not establish a value.
Performance ratios use llmopt / llama.cpp and preserve the receipt protocol.
A command-count reduction is not a latency claim.
Argmax preservation is not full-output or full-logit parity.
